lore.etcetera.iridescent_lantern: A lantern imbued with Bismuth so that its glow slowly shifts hue.
lore.etcetera.dice: A die that rolls a random Flux signal when clicked or powered.
lore.etcetera.iridescent_wool: A soft, colourful block imbued with Bismuth so that its hue slowly shifts.
lore.etcetera.iridescent_terracotta: A subdued, colourful block imbued with Bismuth so that its hue slowly shifts.
lore.etcetera.iridescent_concrete: A sleek, colourful block imbued with Bismuth so that its hue slowly shifts.
lore.etcetera.iridescent_glazed_terracot: A opulent, colourful block imbued with Bismuth so that its hue slowly shifts.
lore.etcetera.iridescent_glass: A translucent, colourful block imbued with Bismuth so that its hue slowly shifts.
lore.etcetera.iridescent_glass_pane: A thin, colourful block imbued with Bismuth so that its hue slowly shifts.
lore.etcetera.rubber: Stretchy, slightly bouncy rubber. Used for Rubber Cable, Bouncers, Hoops, and Rubber Buttons.
lore.etcetera.light_bulb: A light source whose brightness can be adjusted by using it.
lore.etcetera.tinted_light_bulb: A coloured light bulb whose brightness can be adjusted. It flickers now and then.
lore.etcetera.dream_catcher: A hanging charm that makes nearby players drowsy at night, letting them sleep even with monsters about, and grants Regeneration and Strength at dawn.
lore.etcetera.terracotta_vase: A vase that holds flowers and Bouquets, and lines up anything placed on top of it so it sits straight.
lore.etcetera.glow_item_stand: A glowing item stand that displays an item upright. Use Glass on it to encase the item.
lore.etcetera.rubber_chicken: A squeaky rubber duck that floats on water. Give it a squeeze!
lore.etcetera.redstone_wires: Waterproof Flux wire that won't connect to regular Flux Dust, so parallel circuits can sit side by side.
lore.etcetera.item_label: A label that adds custom lines of text to an item's tooltip. Wash it off in a water Cauldron.
lore.etcetera.golden_golem: A tiny golden companion. Throw it to release it: it follows you, heals you, and grants Absorption. Recharge it with Gold Ingots, and sneak-use it to pick it back up.
lore.etcetera.handbell: A small bell. Ring it to call all of your pets that aren't sitting, and make them glow.
lore.etcetera.chisel: A tool that carves blocks into their chiseled form or scrapes off iridescence. Also pries Pearls out of Clams.
lore.etcetera.crumbling_stone: A fragile stone that crumbles away when stood on, jumped on, or hit. Wax it to keep it intact.
lore.etcetera.leveled_stone: An especially smooth stone. Used to make Crumbling Stone.
lore.etcetera.bismuth_block: A solid block of Bismuth whose colour slowly shifts over time.
lore.etcetera.bismuth_ingot: An iridescent metal smelted from Raw Bismuth. Apply it to blocks to make them iridescent, or use it as an Armor Trim material.
lore.etcetera.nether_bismuth_ore: A Nether ore that drops Raw Bismuth Nuggets.
lore.etcetera.raw_bismuth: A chunk of raw ore that can be smelted into Bismuth.
lore.etcetera.squid_lamp: A lamp made from Glow Ink Sacs that shines much brighter underwater.
lore.etcetera.turtle_raft: A nimble one-person raft. It can be dyed and decorated with a banner, and squeezes through one-block gaps.
lore.etcetera.tidal_helmet: A Turtle Shell reinforced with a Heart of the Sea. It charges up Conduit Power to use while underwater.
lore.etcetera.cotton_flower: A soft, fibrous flower that can be woven into clothing, String, or Wool.
lore.etcetera.trader_hood: A cosy cotton hood. It offers no protection, but never wears out.
lore.etcetera.trader_robe: A cosy cotton robe. It offers no protection, but never wears out.
lore.etcetera.prickly_can: A cactus bin. Anything put inside can be destroyed with the click of a button.
lore.etcetera.item_stand: A stand that displays an item upright. Use Glass on it to encase the item.
lore.etcetera.bismuth_bars: It hums at a touch, as if its properties rearrange themselves out of indecision.
